lines.label: Opening duels won
lines.unit: % of fights you opened or died opening
lines.hint: The first kill of a fight (more than 10 s after the last one): how often it was yours rather than you dying.

lines.label: Opening kills
lines.hint: First kills of fights you got.

lines.label: First pick of the round
lines.hint: Rounds where the first kill was yours.

lines.label: First death of the round
lines.hint: Rounds where you were the first to die.

lines.label: Kills traded back
lines.hint: Your team lost someone within 3 s of your kill, so it opened nothing.

lines.label: Died right after your kill
lines.hint: You died within 3 s of your own kill: often a sign of not repositioning.

lines.label: Trades
lines.hint: You killed back within 3 s of losing a teammate.

lines.label: Clean-ups
lines.hint: Kills while your team was already up a player. Not bad, but they rarely decide a fight.

lines.label: Picks into a ready charge
lines.hint: Medic, Demoman, Heavy or Pyro killed while their team held a ready uber.

lines.label: Drops
lines.hint: Medics killed holding a ready uber.

lines.label: Forced ubers
lines.hint: Enemy ubers popped right after your damage on the Medic.

lines.label: Deaths during your uber
lines.hint: Dying while your team's uber is in use.
